title: DREAMY TRIAL (Digitone insert)
author: analoglav
description: Experimental insert on Digitone master output. FM voices, stock chorus/delay/reverb and EUREKA video retained. Two grain pitch voices (+5/+12), stereo filtered feedback delay and damped reverb. Mod Menu DREAMY toggles. AUTO MIDI CC60 mix, 61 time, 62 room. Fixed-point, 32 stereo samples/block. Needs core-dn1 4.1.
